verdict.rationale: Goodwin's own technology industry page says it supports clients at all stages of the corporate life cycle, including IPOs and M&A. It also points to an 'IPO Readiness at Goodwin' resource, and the Liquidation Calculator models proceeds under exit scenarios. However, the evidence includes no dedicated M&A or capital-markets practice page and no documented deal experience specific to venture-backed company exits. Missing for 10: dedicated M&A and IPO practice pages, concrete exit track record or deal examples for venture-backed companies, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm can carry the company through to exit — M&A and public-offering experience for venture-backed companies is documented on its own pages
